camel_example: aliyun devops POST /api/v4/projects/code_reviews/comments/create_comment --region cn-hangzhou --organizationId 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --localId 1 --repositoryIdentity '2835387 或 codeup/codeup-demo' --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"commentType":"GLOBAL_COMMENT","content":"评论内容"}'
description_en: Creates a comment on a merge request. You can create global comments and inline comments. The comment nesting level generally does not exceed three levels
description_zh: 创建合并请求评论，可创建整体评论和行内评论。创建的评论层级一般不要超过3层
kebab_example: aliyun devops create-comment --organization-id 5ebbc0228123212b59xxxxx --repository-identity '2835387 或 codeup/codeup-demo' --local-id 1 --content '评论内容' --comment-type GLOBAL_COMMENT --api-version 2021-06-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateComment

parameters.help_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the enterprise ID. This is a string that can be obtained from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId]
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and AccessKey secret or Security Token Service (STS) temporary authorization
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the code repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The local ID of the merge request, which indicates the sequence number of the merge request in the code repository
parameters.help_zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
parameters.name: local_id

parameters.help_en:
The comment type. Valid values:
GLOBAL_COMMENT: global comment
INLINE_COMMENT: inline file comment
parameters.help_zh:
评论类型

GLOBAL_COMMENT：全局评论
INLINE_COMMENT：文件行内评论
parameters.name: comment_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the comment is a draft
parameters.name: draft

parameters.help_en:
The file path.

This value is required only when commentType is set to INLINE_COMMENT
parameters.help_zh:
文件路径


当commentType=INLINE_COMMENT时，才需要传入值
parameters.name: file_path

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the base version for comparison.

<notice>If you create a comment of the INLINE_COMMENT type, this value is required.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
比较起始的版本ID

<notice>若是创建INLINE_COMMENT类型的评论，则该值必传></notice>
parameters.name: from_pach_set_biz_id

parameters.help_en: The line number of the file where the comment is located. This parameter is available only for inline file comments
parameters.help_zh: 评论所在的文件行号，仅文件行内评论才有
parameters.name: line_number

parameters.help_en: The business ID of the parent comment
parameters.name: parent_comment_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the associated merge request version.
<notice>If you create a comment of the INLINE_COMMENT type, this value is required.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
关联的合并请求版本ID
<notice>若是创建INLINE_COMMENT类型的评论，则该值必传></notice>
parameters.name: patch_set_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the comment is resolved.

<notice>If the business ID of the parent comment is empty, meaning a root comment is being created, you must set the value of resolved.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
是否已解决

<notice>若是父评论业务ID为空，即创建根评论时，必须设置resolved的值></notice>
parameters.name: resolved

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target version for comparison.

<notice>If you create a comment of the INLINE_COMMENT type, this value is required.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
比较目标的版本ID

<notice>若是创建INLINE_COMMENT类型的评论，则该值必传></notice>
